facts.text: I am planning a family gathering to celebrate my grandma's life.
I want to make a photo album or scrapbook with pictures from my grandma's funeral and other fond memories.
My grandma's funeral was on February 15th.
I found my grandma's funeral on February 15th a really tough day for me and my family.
I like the idea of a chronological order for the album.
I am not sure about using a sectional approach for the album.
I want to include a quote on the title page that resonates with me.
I want the title page to be simple yet meaningful.
I am thinking of using a simple title page with a bold font and a small photo of my grandma.
I like the quote "A grandmother is a little bit of heaven on earth."
I am thinking of using the Classic Elegance design idea for the title page.
I like using a bold serif font for the title.
I like using a smaller script font for the quote.
I plan to place a round photo of my grandma in the top-right corner.
I am thinking of using the Traditional Elegance font pairing idea.
I plan to use Times New Roman as the title font.
I plan to use Lobster Script as the quote font.
I plan to use a font size of 18 points for the title.
I plan to use a font size of 12 points for the quote.
I plan to use a black font color for the title and quote.
I plan to leave whitespace around the title and quote to create a clean and uncluttered design.
I want the album layout to include a mix of photos, journaling, and memorabilia on the inside pages.
